mappings.reason: ADRs 0004/0013/0014/0028/0039: executable array-only GSTL resource with bounded raw/PNG/WebP and legacy/KTX2 Basis LDR/HDR channel-role decoding, complete homogeneous mips, atomic Load/LoadPath and stable resource RID, independent reads/copies, typed cache/Replace/worker loading and embedded source archives. Independent pixel oracles and Linux Wayland GPU layer/mip texel fetches, HDR/readback/replacement lifetime and warmed frames verify the consumer; Compatibility explicitly rejects custom shader use. Shared ETC1/ETC2/EAC/ASTC decoding now prepares every channel/HDR/mip role; independent public file/resource/archive tests and actual GPU array sampling/readback verify those source layouts. Partial: R16I/Rg16I/Rgb16I/Rgba16I require integer sampler reflection/binding and prepared/upload storage integration; those raw imported formats still reject at preparation. This affects Load and the LoadPath setter as well as both type contracts. Cube/volume roles remain excluded. Foreign execution, native allocation totals and refreshed public bundle publication are separate verification gates.
